issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() with return type int, while the template's TODO comment and the solution implementation use double for this method. This inconsistency can confuse students about which return type to implement and may cause mismatches with provided tests or the intended solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across all materials. Preferably update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double (to match the template hint and solution) or, if integer division was intended, change the template comment and solution to return int. Also update any explanatory text to mention the chosen return type.
